mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.store_id, st.name AS store_name, s.course_id, c.name AS course_name, c.type AS course_type, dt.id AS dance_type_id, dt.name AS dance_type_name, dt.intro AS dance_type_intro, lv.id AS level_id, lv.name AS level_name, lv.sort AS level_sort, c.duration_min, c.cost_hours, c.description, s.teacher_id, t.name AS teacher_name, t.avatar AS teacher_avatar, t.intro AS teacher_intro, s.room, s.song, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.capacity, s.booked_count, s.status, (SELECT b.status FROM booking b WHERE b.schedule_id = s.id AND b.student_id = #{studentId} AND b.status IN ('booked','checked','waitlist') LIMIT 1) AS my_booking_status FROM course_schedule s LEFT JOIN store st ON st.id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN dance_type dt ON dt.id = c.dance_type_id LEFT JOIN course_level lv ON lv.id = c.level_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.id = s.teacher_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_schedule (store_id, course_id, teacher_id, room, song, start_time, end_time, capacity, booked_count, status) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, #{room}, #{song}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{capacity}, 0, 'open')
mapper.update: UPDATE course_schedule SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE course_schedule SET booked_count = booked_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND booked_count < capacity AND status = 'open'
UPDATE course_schedule SET booked_count = booked_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND booked_count > 0
UPDATE course_schedule SET status = 'finished' WHERE status IN ('open','full') AND end_time < #{now}
